summary: Both halves inspected. The page heading has a distinct older vertical impression beneath2,retained as uncertain1. Needed and expected have typed overstrikes at the final d;into has pen retouching of t/o. Three Hotab forms have displaced o impressions:below the o in the initial chain,above it in the square,and a separately pen-cancelled lower o in the prose. The cancelled Hotab fragment has only a raised cup-like remnant at its second-letter position. More has a pen-retouched o above a cancelled unreadable lower mark. The mark after out for is a lowered typed cancellation over uncertain comma-like punctuation,not a free-standing star. The word insertion say is given its word boundary. All arrows in both diagrams and inline displays are handwritten;their topology is unchanged.

The final d contains an older rounded typed impression whose letter cannot be securely recovered.
The small lowered mark has the crossed diagonal and serif form of a typed x cancellation over a comma-like lower remnant. It is not a separate asterisk;the old punctuation remains doubtful.
The live o is reinforced in pen. A distinct lower impression is heavily covered by pen cancellation and remains unreadable.
The x between want and to is a cancellation stroke occupying a word space,not a lexical x.
